purpose: Three homepage cover options with a distant, softly defocused movement practice, no recognizable faces, and clear outdoor/office surroundings.

images.alt: Un petit groupe pratique des mouvements au loin dans le jardin d’un immeuble de bureaux lumineux.
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: production homepage hero photograph for Vivimoves, a French corporate movement and wellbeing website. One standalone wide landscape image, 2048x1152, 16:9. Editorial architectural lifestyle photography, airy luminous daylight, warm cream and oak, natural greenery and subtle amber accents matching the site's warm neutral style. The surroundings, natural light and sense of space are the main subject. A small workplace group practices a simple standing movement session FAR IN THE DISTANCE. Every person is photographed strictly from behind, turned away from the camera; absolutely no visible faces, facial profiles, eyes, facial features or recognizable identities. People remain softly out of focus while environmental foreground details are in focus. Their complete bodies are small in frame (about 8–12 percent of image height), well spaced with anatomically natural silhouettes. The practice should be legible from relaxed raised arms or simple side stretches, not close-up demonstration. Welcoming, calm, believable French workplace, no staged smiling portraits. Generous visual breathing room suitable for a homepage hero and responsive crops; no embedded text. No logos, lettering, watermark, UI, borders, panels, collage, harsh contrast, gloomy scene or identifiable faces.
Scene: a landscaped garden immediately beside a contemporary low-rise French office building, clearly outdoors. A sunlit pale stone path, ornamental grasses and softly dappled tree shade fill the foreground; large office windows reveal a few desks and chairs within, making the workplace context clear. Camera looks across the garden from about twenty-five meters away toward four distant coworkers, all backs to camera, on a small flat lawn doing a gentle standing stretch with arms relaxed overhead. Focus on grasses and warm office architecture; distant people gently defocused. Bright late-morning light, fresh but restrained greenery, luminous open atmosphere. Composition reads as a real outdoor workplace wellbeing break; people occupy only a small part of the middle distance, no face visible even in profile.
